action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== 1. CHECKOUT STABLE BRANCH ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git fetch origin && git checkout fix/esm-stable 2>&1 | tail -3")
print(stdout.read().decode())

print("=== 2. BUILD ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
result = stdout.read().decode()
print(result)

# Check success
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nDist:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
